about: The one table of engine families: a root engine and its forks, in Setup's order (collectors/engine_families.py reads it). provider is the adapter that runs a fork (collectors/providers.ENGINES); the engine scan finds a fork with a provider (collectors/engine_scan.PRIMARY). A fork with no provider is found by env (one env var naming the binary or checkout), then paths (globs, ~ is the home folder), then binary on PATH. formats are the weight formats (profile/gguf.py GGML_TYPE_NAMES) only that fork reads: a model in one needs it. runs says whether BoltBeam can run it yet; why says why not, when it cannot. flags (llama.cpp): per program, the command-line flags of BoltBeam's engine settings that build has (capture_settings.LLAMA_FLAGS), read from its --help (upstream: the pinned b11571; master 7592b61d3, 2026-11-11); a run that asks for a flag its build lacks is refused.

forks.label: master
forks.why: upstream master pinned at a commit, ahead of the latest release (v0.9.0 lacks the MoE cache's CPU-computed misses #30966, #31233, #31888 and the MTP fixes #31497, #31927; owner 2026-11-10: test now, do not wait for v0.10.0); run it with BOLTBEAM_LLAMA_BENCH set to its llama-bench; Setup cannot pick it yet

forks.label: Strata
forks.why: BoltBeam has no adapter for it yet (docs/recommended-setup.md, models past VRAM)

forks.label: Strata (stripped)
forks.why: UnbiasedStrata, a community fork of PolyStrata v0.1.45-poly.1 (itself from Niko1221/Strata) with a C++ front end and no installer; its engine is v0.1.45, older than upstream Strata's 0.1.59; run it through collectors/strata_stripped.py, Setup cannot pick it yet

forks.label: upstream
forks.why: BoltBeam times tinygrad's roles through the fork's own timing and search provider
